verdict.rationale: The only calendar evidence is a changelog note that external AI apps can connect through Missive's MCP server and act on your calendar. That implies Missive hosts calendar data itself, but nothing documents a calendar view, invite responses, or event creation inside the email client. missing for 10: documented in-client calendar view, RSVP/invite-response capability, in-app event creation, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
